messages:
maria: FYI post-deploy smoke failing in us-east-2 after rolling search-optimizer-2.0. canary probes show repeated 504s during prefill. @zhou can you take a look?

zhou: got it. which canary id/region? i'll pull synth traces.

maria: canary=search-opt-2.0-canary-20260325, region=us-east-2. quick repro: ```curl -sS -X POST https://use2.search.redwood/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE' -d '{"q":"test"}' -w "
HTTP:%{http_code}
"``` -> HTTP:504, body: {"error":"prefill_timeout"}.

synth-bot: synthetic-runner alert: scenario "search-basic" p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s and 504 count 23 in 1m window.

deploy-bot: rollout: search-optimizer-2.0 -> us-east-2 (canary=7%) at 3891233950. initial health checks OK.

zhou: traces show the search-backend requesting an extra shard during warmstart for 2.0 (shard v2 schema). shard fetches hit CDN and some requests stalled, causing prefill to exceed probe deadline.

maria: hmm shard fetch mismatch. could be an artifact mismatch or a routing rule that sends 2.0 to the new shard set prematurely. prefer pin to stable while we confirm. pinging infra.

sam: infra here. quick check: artifact manifest for 2.0 references shard-set b, but CDN config for us-east-2 still serving shard-set a for some edge nodes. likely propagation lag.

maria: thanks. plan A: pause rollout, route region back to search-optimizer-1.9.8 (pin). Plan B: full rollback if pin doesn't stabilize. Thoughts?

zhou: +1 for pin. faster to restore traffic and gives us time to fix CDN propagation and artifact manifest. also will repro warmstart locally with mismatched shards to test behavior.

ops-bot: incident INC-9011 created: "search-optimizer prefill 504s us-east-2" assigned to zhou, sam.

sam: applying route pin to search-optimizer-1.9.8 for us-east-2 now (canary->stable). ETA ~90s.

maria: lowering smoke timeout for the probe to be more sensitive while we monitor. adding release note line: "us-east-2 canary paused for search-optimizer-2.0 due to prefill shard propagation mismatch; pinned to 1.9.8 pending fix."

deploy-bot: route pin applied: us-east-2 -> search-optimizer-1.9.8. smoke probes returning to green.

zhou: running local repro with intentionally mismatched shard manifests and instrumented prefill timing. will post logs and a short blurb in ~25m.

maria: don't escalate to global rollback yet. keep the pin until we confirm CDN consistency and a safe rollout plan (stagger artifacts + warmstart prefetch).

ops-bot: runbook reminder: follow release pin checklist before rollback: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins

sam: also scheduling a quick CDN edge purge for us-east-2 and will coordinate a staggered re-roll once validated.

zhou: will include repro steps and a suggested hotfix (prefetch primary shards before switching routing) in the incident. leaving thread open for handoff.

maria: thanks team, cc'ing product for visibility. :thumbsup:
